# JockShock

> JockShock is a pro-grade athletic gear deodorizer. The active is hypochlorous acid (HOCl) — the same molecule human neutrophils make — powered by EPA-registered ZeroPoint Technology. Built by D1 athletes for pads, skates, gloves, helmets, cleats, mouthguards, and the bag. No fragrance. No bleach. Kills odor at the source. Not a perfume for a hockey bag.

Made in the USA. 32oz matte-black bottle. Free shipping at $59.99 (Athlete Pack). 30-day money-back. The EPA registration belongs to ZeroPoint; JockShock is powered by it.

## Chemistry (what it IS)

- Active: hypochlorous acid (HOCl). Same molecule white blood cells produce via myeloperoxidase.
- Bleach is mostly hypochlorite (OCl⁻, charged). HOCl has no charge. The literature measures HOCl at tens of times more effective than the hypochlorite ion.
- Powered by EPA-registered ZeroPoint Technology. Do not write “JockShock is EPA-registered.”
- Kills odor / kills the funk. Do not write that it kills bacteria, germs, or microbes. Not a disinfectant or sanitizer. No 99.9% claim.
